id: \bBrock: You're here to take her back, aren't you? I won't let that happen!
en: \bBrock: You're here to take her back, aren't you? I won't let that happen!
it: \bBrock: Sei qui per portarla via, vero? Non lo permetterò!

en: \bBrock: \PN. I'm sorry for attacking you. I think I was hypnotized.
it: \bBrock: \PN. Scusa se ti ho attaccato. Credo di essere stato ipnotizzato.

id: \bPrepare to be amazed.
en: \bPrepare to be amazed.
it: \bPreparati a rimanere a bocca aperta.

id: \bTell your friends to visit the city of mushrooms.
en: \bTell your friends to visit the city of mushrooms.
it: \bDì ai tuoi amici di venire a visitare la città dei funghi.

id: The Hatterene fled.
en: The Hatterene fled.
it: Hatterene è fuggito.

id: \bYou look nice. Care to talk for a minute?
en: \bYou look nice. Care to talk for a minute?

id: \bI want to take a ride with someone special. Isn't that what we're all looking for?
en: \bI want to take a ride with someone special. Isn't that what we're all looking for?
it: \bVorrei fare un giro con qualcuno di speciale. Non è quello che cerchiamo tutti?

id: \bCilan: I think Brock is somewhere close by.
en: \bCilan: I think Brock is somewhere close by.
it: \bSpighetto: Credo che Brock sia da qualche parte qui vicino.

id: \bI miss my father.
en: \bI miss my father.
it: \bMi manca mio padre.

id: \bYou never know who you'll end up missing. Always make sure to voice your feelings.
en: \bYou never know who you'll end up missing.  Always make sure to voice your feelings.
it: \bNon si sa mai chi finirà per mancarti. Esprimi sempre i tuoi sentimenti.
